goal: Compare user skills with opportunity requirements, calculate match percentages, and save results to script.js without altering existing functionality.

steps.title: Load user skill data and opportunity requirement data
steps.description: Parse existing user skills and each opportunity's required skills from their respective data sources.

steps.title: Calculate match percentage, matching skills, and missing skills
steps.description: For every opportunity, compute match % as (matching required skills / total required skills)*100, list matching and missing skills.

steps.title: Run existing verification checks and fix errors
steps.description: Execute existing checks ensuring login and profile functionality remain unchanged; resolve any identified issues.

steps.title: Validate results and save to script.js
steps.description: Check results against file entries, then save the output to script.js while preserving all previously written code.
